summary: Wrote a 3-email launch sequence for Momentum based on the T2 messaging framework. Email 1 (Hook) leads with the problem of rigid habit trackers and streak shame. Email 2 (Demo) walks through a real day with Momentum's energy-adaptive scheduling. Email 3 (Close) delivers urgency with a 30-day streak starter offer. All emails use the grounded, humanizing, precise tone from T2. Each email is under 150 words in body copy.
